columns.name: Diabetes_binary
columns.description: Binary target label: 0 = no diabetes; 1 = prediabetes or diabetes.

columns.name: HighBP
columns.description: Binary indicator: whether the individual has been told by a health professional that they have high blood pressure (0 = no, 1 = yes).

columns.name: HighChol
columns.description: Binary indicator: whether the individual has been told by a health professional that their blood cholesterol is high (0 = no, 1 = yes).

columns.name: CholCheck
columns.description: Binary indicator: whether the individual had a cholesterol check within the past five years (0 = no, 1 = yes).

columns.name: BMI
columns.description: The Body Mass Index (BMI) of the individual, an indicator of body fat based on height and weight.

columns.name: Smoker
columns.description: Binary indicator: whether the individual has smoked at least 100 cigarettes in their lifetime (0 = no, 1 = yes).

columns.name: Stroke
columns.description: Binary indicator: whether the individual has ever been told they had a stroke (0 = no, 1 = yes).

columns.name: HeartDiseaseorAttack
columns.description: Binary indicator: whether the individual has reported coronary heart disease or myocardial infarction/heart attack (0 = no, 1 = yes).

columns.name: PhysActivity
columns.description: Binary indicator: whether the individual engaged in physical activity or exercise in the past 30 days, excluding their regular job (0 = no, 1 = yes).

columns.name: Fruits
columns.description: Binary indicator: whether the individual consumes fruit one or more times per day (0 = no, 1 = yes).

columns.name: Veggies
columns.description: Binary indicator: whether the individual consumes vegetables one or more times per day (0 = no, 1 = yes).

columns.name: HvyAlcoholConsump
columns.description: Binary indicator: heavy alcohol consumption according to the dataset/codebook definition (0 = no, 1 = yes).

columns.name: AnyHealthcare
columns.description: Binary indicator: whether the individual has any kind of health-care coverage (0 = no, 1 = yes).

columns.name: NoDocbcCost
columns.description: Binary indicator: whether the individual needed to see a doctor in the past 12 months but could not because of cost (0 = no, 1 = yes).

columns.name: GenHlth
columns.description: Ordinal self-rated general-health category on a 1-to-5 scale, where 1 = excellent and 5 = poor.

columns.name: MentHlth
columns.description: Count of days in the past 30 days on which the individual reported poor mental health.

columns.name: PhysHlth
columns.description: Count of days in the past 30 days on which the individual reported poor physical health.

columns.name: DiffWalk
columns.description: Binary indicator: whether the individual has serious difficulty walking or climbing stairs (0 = no, 1 = yes).

columns.name: Sex
columns.description: Binary-coded sex attribute: 0 = female, 1 = male.

columns.name: Age
columns.description: Ordinal age-group category with 13 ordered levels (for example, 1 = age 18-24 and 13 = age 80 or older).

columns.name: Education
columns.description: Ordinal education-level category on a 1-to-6 scale, from lower educational attainment to college education or more.

columns.name: Income
columns.description: Ordinal household-income category on a 1-to-8 scale, from lower to higher income brackets.
